series_key: self optimizing expert advisors in mql5
idea_name: SVD Sigma spectrum as market energy/stability filter
mechanism: Row-normalize OHLC into matrix X, run truncated SVD (OpenBLAS SingularValueDecompositionDC or native SVD); normalize singular values S/sum(S). Few large near-nonzero Σ entries ⇒ stable, single-mode sentiment; many large entries ⇒ chaotic/high-energy market. Train-set Σ can look similar across assets; test-set Σ exposed BTCETH with two large modes vs EURUSD’s one.
data_needed: OHLC rate matrix (features×bars), row norms or means; OpenBLAS/MQL5 SVD; optional ATR for cross-check
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD vs BTCETH; PERIOD_CURRENT script FETCH bars; ATR on M1 for volatility illustration; EA uses H1 MA24, bars=10, horizon=10; USDJPY-style pair Jan 2023–Mar 2025
why_new_for_mis: Turns the singular-value spectrum into an unsupervised multi-mode energy/stability sensor—complementary to ATR—usable as a scalping-vs-trend regime filter without labeled outcomes.
quote: Stable markets will only have one large entry in the S factor, and all other entries will be close to 0. The more entries in S that are far from 0, the more chaotic and volatile a market appears to be according to the data.

series_key: self optimizing expert advisors in mql5
idea_name: SVD U columns as latent market driving forces
mechanism: U from X=UΣVᵀ encodes latent factors over OHLC rows: e.g. a column with all-negative loadings is a depreciating force across OHLC; positive-dominant columns are bullish. VT shows which force dominates each historical time column; largest Σ picks the dominant force. Author interprets factors as investor-sentiment modes.
data_needed: Normalized OHLC feature×time matrix; U, Σ, VT from SVD
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD (and BTCETH in energy section); PERIOD_CURRENT FETCH-length windows
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS an interpretable latent-factor regime reading—sign patterns of U plus time loadings in V—without supervised labels.
quote: U is describing hidden market forces that appear to be "driving" our market's observed behaviour. ... Given that we are working with historical market data, the market forces we are analyzing may actually represent underlying investor sentiment.

series_key: self optimizing expert advisors in mql5
idea_name: ΣV principal components for decorrelated signal extraction
mechanism: Mean-center OHLC rows, SVD, form PC=Diag(S)·VT (PCA). Frobenius norm of CorrCoef drops vs raw X; keep top-k PC rows (e.g. 3 of 5) as less-correlated features for PInv regression to future close—feature extraction that exposes dominant trends by stripping redundancy.
data_needed: Mean-centered OHLC matrix; truncated SVD; optional target close series for PCA-OLS
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Symbol() PERIOD_CURRENT; FETCH bars train/test split by horizon; same EURUSD/crypto context as SVD demos
why_new_for_mis: Supplies a fast native-MQL5 unsupervised front-end that compresses correlated OHLC into dominant orthogonal signals MIS can monitor as a trend/structure sensor.
quote: matrix factorization using SVD can be used to remove redundant correlated features in the original dataset, and hopefully by doing so, we aim to better expose the dominant trends and patterns in the data.

series_key: self optimizing expert advisors in mql5
idea_name: Rolling Z-scored SVD OLS fair-value MA forecast
mechanism: Each new H1 candle: Z-score open/high/low/close and MA over `bars` (mean/std), pack into X with intercept row; target y = current MA window; fit b via OpenBLAS SVD pseudoinverse; predict next MA. Trade mean-reversion vs price: buy if prediction>close, sell if prediction<close; ATR-based trailing stops.
data_needed: OHLC + iMA buffer; rolling mean/std Z1/Z2; OpenBLAS SVD each bar; ATR(14)
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: H1 (input TIME_FRAME=PERIOD_H1); MA_PERIOD=24 SMA close; bars=10, horizon=10; ~Jan 2023–Mar 2025 backtest (USDJPY-style pair in text)
why_new_for_mis: Online factorization yields a continuously refreshed fair-value/expected-MA sensor from raw OHLC—MIS can treat prediction−price as an over/undervaluation state without hand-coded indicator rules.
quote: Our strategy aims to learn a fair market price by forecasting the moving average indicator's future value. This expected value is going to help us place our trades in the sense that, when price levels are above our expectations, we will sell because we believe the market is overvalued.

series_key: self optimizing expert advisors in mql5
idea_name: Linear system-ID feedback gate on expected balance
mechanism: For 90 D1 scenes, snapshot OHLC(1), EMA(42), equity, balance into FEATURES×scenes. Once filled, build X (intercept + 7 state rows) and y = next-step balance; SVD → coefficients b; forecast balance from current state. Enter MA cross trades only if forecast balance > AccountInfo balance; else wait—feedback controller learns when the fixed MA strategy is capital-efficient.
data_needed: Rolling matrix of open/high/low/close, MA, equity, balance; OBSERVATIONS=90; OpenBLAS/MQL5 SVD; ATR(14)×2 SL/TP padding
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart Symbol(); PERIOD_D1; EMA period 42 close; ATR 14; Jan 2023–May 2025 backtest/forward half
why_new_for_mis: Senses strategy–market coupling regime: the identified linear map from market+account state to future balance is a data-driven go/no-go sensor for when a rule set is entering a profitable vs decaying regime—without retuning MA length.
quote: If the forecasted balance exceeds the current one, the system proceeds to trade; otherwise, it waits for better market conditions.
